## Important Rules

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Always browse | Every /qa run opens the browser and tests the running app, including runs where the diff is backend, config, or prompt-only. Never substitute evals, unit tests, or curl for the browser pass. |
| Evidence | One screenshot minimum per issue; retry once before documenting. |
| Console | Check after every interaction. |
| Credentials | Never write them; use `[REDACTED]`. |
| Output | Never delete screenshots or earlier reports. |
